title: PhotoPrism
wrapper_note:
PhotoPrism only creates its first administrator when PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD
is set. The wrapper generates a random password once, stores it in the mounted
storage volume, prints it to the log, then hands over to the image's original
/init. It is not a privilege wrapper: the container still runs as uid 1000 and
the upstream image is unmodified.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Admin password bootstrap.** PhotoPrism refuses to create the first admin without `PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD`. `src/entrypoint.sh` generates a random password once, stores it in `storage/admin-password.txt`, prints it to `docker logs`, and then execs the image's original `/init`. The container still runs as uid 1000.
descript: PhotoPrism is a self-hosted photo and video library with AI-powered search. Point it at a folder of originals and it indexes your media, recognises faces, objects and places, and lets you browse, search, tag and share from a clean web UI. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container, keeps originals and the index in the application data folder, and creates a random administrator password on first start.
release_note: 1. First release: PhotoPrism 261029 from Docker Hub, x86_64 + aarch64, non-root, with automatic administrator password bootstrap.
important: Login: admin plus the random password printed by docker logs photoprismdocker and stored in DockerAppData/photoprismdocker/storage/admin-password.txt - change it in Settings. Put photos in DockerAppData/photoprismdocker/originals; the import folder is .../import. Needs DockerEngine; add a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up storage and originals before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

data_notes: Three mounted folders: `storage` holds the index database, settings, cache and the generated admin password; `originals` is the photo/video library the app indexes and serves; `import` is an optional drop folder for bulk imports. Copying `storage` and `originals` is a complete backup.
design_notes: **Admin password bootstrap.** The image does not create an admin when `PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD` is empty. `src/entrypoint.sh` generates a random password once and stores it in the storage volume, then execs the original `/init`.
**Non-root.** The container runs as `1000:1000`; verified on real hardware that `/init` and the PhotoPrism server work unprivileged.
**Three volumes, one port.** `storage` + `originals` + `import`; only the web UI port 2342 is published.
**Health check** probes `/` on 2342; PhotoPrism answers with a 307 redirect to the login page.
**Fixed image tag**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no host network, no Docker socket.
limitations: AI face/object recognition runs on the CPU by default. Large libraries need RAM and CPU; GPU acceleration is not enabled by this package.
The app does not create a photo library. Put your photos into `originals` (or use the import folder); otherwise the library stays empty.
The first admin password is generated on first start. If you lose it, read the file in `storage` or reset it from the container command line; changing it in Settings is recommended.
Plain HTTP on the LAN; do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.
One library per instance: the container mounts a single `originals` folder.
